title: Create Your First Unity Project
description: Install Unity Hub, download an Editor version, and create a new 3D Core project named 'HelloUnity'.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Set up Unity on your computer and create a blank project.

1.  Download and install Unity Hub from [unity.com](https://unity.com).
2.  In the Hub, install a Unity Editor version (preferably the latest LTS) with the Visual Studio module.
3.  Create a **new project** using the **3D Core** template.
4.  Name the project `HelloUnity` and choose a location.
5.  Once the Editor opens, locate the **Project** window and observe the default folder structure.

Take a screenshot of the Unity Editor with the project open.
hints: Make sure to install Visual Studio (or VS Code) as part of the modules so you can write scripts later.
If the Editor takes long to open, it's normal on first launch – it's importing assets.
expectedOutput: A screenshot showing the Unity Editor with the HelloUnity project loaded, visible Project and Hierarchy windows.
solutionCode: No code required. Follow the step-by-step guide above.
